## What

One to three lines. The diff shows the rest.

## Why

The bulk of it: the problem this solves, the decisions taken, the trade-offs, and any alternative that was considered and rejected.

## Checks

- [ ] `bin/ci` is green locally
- [ ] A feature ships with a test, a bugfix with a regression test
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` updated if behavior, setup or the release flow changed
